task: Fix 8 TS7053 errors in ConsolidationEngine.test.ts where result[0]/result[1] was indexing the { entities, ctaDetails } wrapper object.

errors_before.root_cause: translateForeignSubsidiaries returns { entities: EntityData[]; ctaDetails: CTADetail[] }; tests were treating the wrapper as an array, so result[0]/result[1] gave 'any'.

approach_per_call_site.rationale: skips parent (index 0) explicitly, names the foreign sub clearly, used twice

approach_per_call_site.pattern: single-entity USD test, accesses result[0] once
approach_per_call_site.rationale: single use, named binding documents intent

approach_per_call_site.pattern: single-entity no-FX test, accesses result[0] once
approach_per_call_site.rationale: single use, named binding documents intent

approach_per_call_site.pattern: three-assertion test on the same entity's entries
approach_per_call_site.rationale: three uses — pulling entries out avoids repeating result.entities[0].entries[N]

approach_summary: Destructured at all 4 call sites (zero 'as' casts, zero type assertions, all bindings properly typed as EntityData / JournalEntry[]). Chose destructuring over 'as EntityData' because noUncheckedIndexedAccess is false, so destructured bindings stay strictly typed and document intent better than casts.

regression_check.note: 3 pre-existing errors remain in App.tsx and DepreciationPage.test.tsx (default-export issues). None in our target file, none introduced by this change.
